mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% indicates suppressed consumer spending power, reducing corporate revenue visibility and driving negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1000.0 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1000.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent price pressures, prompting anticipated Fed tightening that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through reduced aggregate demand.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline from prior month
failure_condition: When both HOUST and INDPRO decline from prior month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals aggressive monetary accommodation in a weak labor market, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising at least 0.25% in 3 months), higher discount rates and reduced liquidity cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: During periods with FEDFUNDS rising ≥0.25% in 3 months, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment expansion regimes (UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS annual growth < 0.5%), weak labor market dynamics suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: In periods meeting UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS annual growth < 0.5%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
